title: This year's roadmap
label: A product roadmap from Q1 to Q4 with three tracks: Product, Platform and Customers. A Today marker walks the year; shipped milestones fill in, ranges fill as it passes, planned ones stay outlined. At the public API launch in August its flag opens into a card.
heading:

sub: Our public plan, updated every quarter. Ask us about anything on it.
